arguments.body:
The issue "App crashes on startup after upgrade" appears to describe a crash occurring right at app startup following an upgrade. This is likely a regression because the crash began after the upgrade event, impacting the app’s ability to boot normally.

Triage note: CANARY_850e98f10a61 - Immediate investigation is recommended to confirm the regression impact and identify the root cause to enable a quick fix or rollback.
